verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's documentation describes a single API endpoint covering 80+ providers and 500+ models. It says the schema is normalized across models and providers so you only need to learn one, tool calling is standardized, and the OpenAI SDK works as a drop-in replacement. Independent community reports confirm that the same API key and request work across models and that you can switch models in production with minimal effort.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call many model providers through one consistent API

citations.quote: OpenRouter gives you access to hundreds of AI models through a single API endpoint.
OpenRouter normalizes the schema across models and providers so you only need to learn one.
OpenRouter standardizes the tool calling interface across models and providers
the ability to run any AI model with the same api key and same request has been great to experiment with new models and being able to switch models in prod with minimal effort
It's definitely the best way to try out new models without fiddling with each providers distinct APIs.
